pr_title: Move OSQUERY_HOME into core and use as filesystem config default

issue_context.title: Linux configuration is preferring the /var/osquery path over /etc/osquery
issue_context.body:
From @zwass:

```
vagrant@vagrant-ubuntu-trusty-64:~$ sudo mv /var/osquery/osquery.conf /etc/osquery/osquery.conf
vagrant@vagrant-ubuntu-trusty-64:~$ sudo osqueryd
W0720 21:39:23.513506  4886 init.cpp:553] Error reading config: config file does not exist: /var/osquery/osquery.conf
^C^Cvagrant@vagrant-ubuntu-trusty-64:~$ sudo mv /etc/osquery/osquery.conf /var/osquery/osquery.conf
vagrant@vagrant-ubuntu-trusty-64:~$ sudo osqueryd
I0720 21:39:39.264104  4905 options.cpp:61] Verbose logging enabled by config option
I0720 21:39:39.264847  4905 events.cpp:669] Event publisher failed setup: kernel: Cannot access /dev/osquery
I0720 21:39:39.265208  4905 syslog.cpp:87] Successfully opened pipe for syslog ingestion
I0720 21:39:39.266332  4905 events.cpp:888] Error registering subscriber: process_file_events: No kernel event publisher
I0720 21:39:39.266855  4905 daemon.cpp:38] Not starting the distributed query service: Distributed query service not enabled.
I0720 21:39:39.267271  4917 events.cpp:605] Starting event publisher run loop: udev
I0720 21:39:39.267544  4916 events.cpp:605] Starting event publisher run loop: syslog
I0720 21:39:39.268578  4915 events.cpp:605] Starting event publisher run loop: inotify
I0720 21:39:39.268980  4914 events.cpp:605] Starting event publisher run loop: audit
```
comments: Is this just because of how `config_path` is defined (https://github.com/facebook/osquery/blob/master/osquery/config/plugins/filesystem.cpp#L27), or is there some code that manipulates it elsewhere? Perhaps the declaration can be `#ifdef`ed?

review_comments:
Is the forward slash going to be a problem for Windows?
Shouldn't be an issue.
